definitions.name: O1D.BDELTAS
definitions.body: CHARS [ '(' '[' ')' ']' ] [ 1 1 -1 -1 ] RECORD 'BR' BIND [ 'BC' BIND BR BC GET ] MAP
definitions.note: bracket String to a Vector of +1 per opener and -1 per closer

definitions.name: O1D.BDEPTH
definitions.body: O1D.BDELTAS 0 [ ADD ] SCAN 0 1 COLLECT CONCAT G0D.MAXV
definitions.note: greatest nesting depth of a bracket String (0 for empty)

definitions.name: O1D.BSTEP
definitions.body: 'C' BIND 'S' BIND S CHARS 'A' BIND A -1 GET C 2 COLLECT JOIN 'P' BIND A -1 DROP JOIN S C 2 COLLECT JOIN 2 COLLECT 0 1 P '()' EQ NOT P '[]' EQ NOT AND NOT SELECT GET
definitions.note: FOLD/SCAN step [stack char]: pops the stack String's last char when it pairs with the char ('()' or '[]'), else appends the char

definitions.name: O1D.BREDUCE
definitions.body: CHARS '.' [ O1D.BSTEP ] FOLD
definitions.note: bracket String reduced by deleting adjacent matched pairs, with a leading '.' sentinel ('.' alone means balanced)

definitions.name: O1D.BPREFIX
definitions.body: CHARS 'CS' BIND 0 CS LENGTH RANGE '.' 1 COLLECT CS '.' [ O1D.BSTEP ] SCAN CONCAT 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET '.' EQ ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP -1 GET
definitions.note: length of the longest balanced prefix of a bracket String (0 when only the empty prefix is)

definitions.name: O1D.LNAMES
definitions.body: [ 0 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: first elements of a Vector of pairs (the names of ledger entries)

definitions.name: O1D.LAMTS
definitions.body: [ 1 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: second elements of a Vector of pairs (the amounts of ledger entries)

definitions.name: O1D.LEDGER
definitions.body: 'L' BIND L O1D.LNAMES L O1D.LAMTS G0A.SUMBY
definitions.note: Vector of [name amount] pairs to a Record name -> sum of amounts, first-appearance order

definitions.name: O1D.DEBTORS
definitions.body: O1D.LEDGER 'R' BIND R KEYS R VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET 0 LT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP
definitions.note: names whose summed amounts are negative, in first-appearance order

definitions.name: O1D.LARGEST-ENTRY
definitions.body: 'L' BIND L L O1D.LAMTS G0A.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: the [name amount] pair with the largest amount, first on ties

definitions.name: O1D.LONGEST
definitions.body: 'W' BIND W W [ CHARS LENGTH ] MAP G0A.ARGMAX GET
definitions.note: longest String in a Vector of Strings, first on ties

definitions.name: O1D.RLESTEP
definitions.body: 'E' BIND 'A' BIND A -1 GET 'P' BIND A -1 DROP P 0 GET P 1 GET 1 ADD 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT A E 1 2 COLLECT 1 COLLECT CONCAT 2 COLLECT 0 1 P 0 GET E EQ SELECT GET
definitions.note: FOLD step [runs elem] over a non-empty Vector of [value count] pairs: bumps the last count when its value equals elem, else appends [elem 1]

definitions.name: O1D.RLE
definitions.body: [ [ 'x' 0 ] ] [ O1D.RLESTEP ] FOLD 1 DROP
definitions.note: run-length encoding of a Vector: [ value count ] per maximal run of equal adjacent values

definitions.name: O1D.UPRUNS
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V 1 DROP V -1 DROP GT 1 [ 'T' BIND 'A' BIND A 1 ADD 1 T SELECT ] SCAN 1 1 COLLECT CONCAT G0D.MAXV
definitions.note: length of the longest strictly increasing stretch of adjacent values (1 for a single value)

definitions.name: O1D.MAJORITY
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V TALLY 'T' BIND T KEYS T VALUES 2 COLLECT ZIP [ 1 GET 2 MUL V LENGTH GT ] FILTER [ 0 GET ] MAP 0 GET
definitions.note: the value occurring in more than half the positions, or NIL when none does

definitions.name: O1D.NILFLAGS
definitions.body: [ NIL? ] MAP
definitions.note: Vector of truths: TRUE where the element is NIL

definitions.name: O1D.PRESENT
definitions.body: [ NIL? NOT ] FILTER
definitions.note: the non-NIL elements of a Vector, in order

definitions.name: O1D.FILLED
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V V O1D.PRESENT 0 GET [ 'E' BIND 'A' BIND A E E NIL? SELECT ] SCAN
definitions.note: forward-fill NILs with the nearest earlier present value; leading NILs take the first present value

definitions.name: O1D.GAPS
definitions.body: O1D.NILFLAGS 'F' BIND F FALSE 1 COLLECT F -1 DROP CONCAT NOT AND G0B.COUNT
definitions.note: number of runs of consecutive NILs in a Vector

definitions.name: O1D.LONGEST-GAP
definitions.body: O1D.NILFLAGS 0 [ 'T' BIND 'A' BIND A 1 ADD 0 T SELECT ] SCAN 0 1 COLLECT CONCAT G0D.MAXV
definitions.note: length of the longest run of consecutive NILs (0 when none)

definitions.name: O1D.RATIO
definitions.body: [ 'P' 'C' ] BIND NIL 1 C C NIL? SELECT 1 P P NIL? SELECT DIV P NIL? NOT C NIL? NOT AND NOT SELECT
definitions.note: pair [prev cur] to cur divided by prev, or NIL when either is NIL

definitions.name: O1D.RATIOS
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V -1 DROP V 1 DROP 2 COLLECT ZIP [ O1D.RATIO ] MAP
definitions.note: each element divided by the one before it (NIL where either is NIL); one shorter than the input

definitions.name: O1D.SCALED
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V O1D.PRESENT G0D.MAXV 'M' BIND V [ 'X' BIND NIL 0 X X NIL? SELECT M DIV X NIL? SELECT ] MAP
definitions.note: each present element divided by the largest present element; NILs stay NIL

definitions.name: O1D.MEDIAN
definitions.body: SORT 'S' BIND S LENGTH 'N' BIND S N 1 SUB 2 DIV FLOOR GET S N 2 DIV FLOOR GET ADD 2 DIV
definitions.note: median of a non-empty Vector of numbers (mean of the two middle ones when even)

definitions.name: O1D.ABS
definitions.body: 'D' BIND D -1 MUL D D 0 LT SELECT
definitions.note: absolute value, lifts over Vectors

definitions.name: O1D.MAD
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V V O1D.MEDIAN SUB O1D.ABS O1D.MEDIAN
definitions.note: median absolute deviation of a Vector of numbers

definitions.name: O1D.MOVING3
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V -2 DROP V 1 DROP -1 DROP V 2 DROP ADD ADD 3 DIV
definitions.note: means of every three consecutive numbers (two fewer elements than the input)

definitions.name: O1D.RUNMAX
definitions.body: 'V' BIND V V 0 GET [ MAX ] SCAN
definitions.note: running maximum of a non-empty Vector of numbers
